newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica's Afribrand over-subscribed 75 times.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica's Afribrand over-subscribed 75 times.

text.p: The public share offering in South Africa's Afribrand Holdings Ltd, due to be listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange on Tuesday, was 75 times oversubscribed, the company said at the weekend.

"Following one of the highest over-subscriptions for a share offer in South African investment history, Afribrand Holdings Ltd lists tomorrow (Tuesday) in the Food sector of the Johannesburg Stock Exchange," it said.

"Local and foreign investors poured 750 million rand into the company's 10 million rand public share offer in efforts to obtain a holding in what is proving to be among the most popular flotations of all time."
Afribrand specialises in marketing and distributing branded products into lower economic markets and particularly hawker shop sectors.
It first announced its intention to list at the start of June.
A private placing of 22 million shares at one rand each drew requests for over three and a half times that amount from leading local institutions.

"This left the 10 million rand public offer shares as the only hope for institutions and individuals -- both foreign and local and they responded by applying for 74 times more shares than are available," the company said.
Afribrand said that the premium on the one rand issue price could be between 150 and 200 cents.
